questions.question: month_key in dates.py fails on 2026-1-5 the same way. Should it change too?

options.label: Both keys
options.adds: Make month_key in dates.py accept unpadded dates the same way.

rewriteBeforeAnswers: Make week_key in dates.py accept unpadded dates like 2026-1-5 from the old bank export. Its date.fromisoformat call currently raises ValueError on them. Change only that parsing, and don't add tests or files. Done when 2026-1-5 is accepted and python3 run_tests.py passes.
final: Make week_key in dates.py accept unpadded dates like 2026-1-5 from the old bank export. Its date.fromisoformat call currently raises ValueError on them. Change only that parsing, and don't add tests or files. Done when 2026-1-5 is accepted and python3 run_tests.py passes. Leave month_key in dates.py unchanged.
